_about: In Loving Memory entries added on deploy by kop_apply_memorial_seeds() (inc/admin.php). Each is inserted once, skipped when memorial_victims already has a row with the same name, program and date. Rows edited on the page are never touched. Source of the first 2026-10-23 batch: the owner's Death Toll sheet (rows with a source that were not on the page; 'sheet_row' is the row there). Second batch ('news_ids'): deaths in KOP's news archive that were not on the page (docs/plan/4.3 item 16). 'corrections': fixes to rows already on the page, applied only while the row still holds every 'expect' value (so once, and never over a later edit), saved through the pencil's kop_ie_row_save().

entries.name: Dakota Underwood
entries.cause_of_death: Stabbed to death near downtown Shawnee, months after running from his juvenile placement in June; a woman and a juvenile were arrested and charged with second-degree murder
entries.notes: Owner: add him (2026-11-22). KFOR (Dylan Brown, Nov. 6, 2024): '17-year-old Dakota Underwood' was 'found killed Saturday in Shawnee', stabbed near 600 N. Hobson; his mother 'says her son was one of many teenagers who escaped the Scissor Tail Landing Detention Center in June.' Saturday = Nov. 2, 2024. KOCO (Dacoda Wahpekeche, Nov. 7, 2024, https://www.koco.com/article/arrests-made-as-family-grieves-17-year-old-died-after-stabbing/62845585): 'he ran away from a juvenile service with Shawnee police confirming'; a woman and a juvenile arrested. Program name as his mother gave it; OJA lists Scissortail Landing (Norman) as a girls' group home, so which OJA placement he left is not settled.

set.notes: A 16-year-old from Santa Rosa, Calif., killed by a falling tree limb as he slept in his tent near Waldo Lake, Willamette National Forest, on the first night of a 21-day trip (The Register-Guard, Mar 28, 2003). Also The Salt Lake Tribune: https://archive.sltrib.com/story.php?ref=/news/ci_7139316. Was: location "Utah" (corrected 2026-11-18).

corrections.why: About rewrite batch 2 (Catherine Freer), 2026-11-18: Cynthia Clark Harvey testified to Congress that this death was in Nevada in October 2002; GAO's Gregory Kutz confirmed it.

set.source_name: U.S. House Committee on Education and Labor hearing, Oct 10, 2007
set.notes: Hearing record p. 128: 'two deaths in Catherine Freer programs after Erica died, one occurred in Nevada ... in October of 2002'; Gregory Kutz (GAO): 'That is correct.' The exact day, age 15 and heart condition come only from the r/troubledteens wiki. Was: Utah, Oct 20, 2002, unsourced (corrected 2026-11-18).

corrections.why: About rewrite batch 2 (Red Rock Canyon School), 2026-11-18: she fell on a Red Rock Canyon School hike on Christmas Day 2001 (The Salt Lake Tribune, May 29, 2002); the owner's Death Toll sheet (row 277) says the same.

set.notes: Michael Vigh, 'Parents Sue Over Girl's Hiking Death', The Salt Lake Tribune, May 29, 2002: she fell down a crevice on Christmas Day 2001 hiking with classmates from Red Rock Canyon School, St. George, and died three weeks later in a Las Vegas hospital; her parents sued the school for $6 million. Was: program "Redrock Ranch Academy", cited to the Tribune's 2024 overview (https://www.sltrib.com/news/2024/05/07/how-utah-became-birthplace-once/) (corrected 2026-11-18).

corrections.why: About rewrite batch 2 (Challenger Foundation), 2026-11-18: the 1990, 1992 and 1995 reports give June 27, 1990; only the 1991 story says June 26.

set.notes: Died June 27, 1990 (Deseret News, Aug 16, 1995; Jul 3, 1990: collapsed about 4 p.m. 'last Wednesday' on Fiftymile Mountain, https://www.deseret.com/1990/7/3/18869659/mother-of-girl-who-collapsed-in-desert-praises-challenger). Was: Jun 26, 1990, from the Deseret News of Jul 24, 1991 (https://www.deseret.com/1991/7/24/18932325/father-sues-challenger-over-daughter-s-death/) (corrected 2026-11-18).

corrections.why: About rewrite batch 3 (Asheville Academy), 2026-11-18: only the first WLOS report (May 8, 2025) said 14; WLOS's report of the state's findings (Jun 18, 2025) and later reports say 13.

corrections.why: About rewrite batch 3 (Echo Glen), 2026-11-18: she was found hanging on March 1, 2001 and died in hospital two days later, on March 3 (Seattle Post-Intelligencer, May 14, 2001; Kitsap Sun, Jun 21, 2001).

set.notes: Found hanging in her room at Echo Glen on March 1, 2001; died in a hospital March 3 after being taken off life support (Seattle Post-Intelligencer, May 14, 2001; Kitsap Sun, Jun 21, 2001: https://web.kitsapsun.com/archive/2001/06-21/0020_state_lockups__suicide_confirms_a.html). Was: Mar 1, 2001, cited to the Snoqualmie Valley Record (https://www.valleyrecord.com/news/suicide-at-echo-glen-spurs-2m-lawsuit/) (corrected 2026-11-18).
